description: Resolve a human symbol / slug / name (e.g. 'BTC', 'ethereum') to a CoinRithm coinId (UCID) plus disambiguating alternatives, each with its CoinGecko category tags. Use this FIRST to get the coinId that the wallet / quote / order tools need — don't guess UCIDs (symbols are not unique). Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

q.description: Symbol, slug, or name (e.g. BTC, bitcoin, Ethereum).

name: resolve_symbol
title: Resolve symbol -> coinId
